name: Fruit Party

features.name: Random multipliers
features.description: Any winning symbol can randomly turn into a 2x multiplier; multipliers on the same cluster are combined.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 3+ scatters award 10+ free spins with more frequent multipliers.

review:
One of Pragmatic's earlier cluster games, and basically the prototype for Sugar Rush. Random 2x multipliers attach to winning symbols and stack when several land in the same cluster.

It's simpler and less dramatic than Sugar Rush, but frequent small cluster wins make it a good pick if you want a fruit game that still has a proper free spins bonus. High volatility, 5,000x max, 96.5% RTP.
cons: Feels dated next to Sugar Rush
Multiplier wins are hard to predict
